title: Early-September ridge — negative case (no deep low)
notes: 5 Sep 2022: ridge/settled conditions over the UK and the Channel after the dry summer of 2022; ex-hurricane Danielle was still far out in the mid-Atlantic, west of the narrowed box (43-58N, 15W-5E). Negative expectation is 'no low below 1005 hPa' — highs count as systems and SHOULD be detected. Confidence: moderate.
